Method of Attack: Forced PC diagnostics scan that returns false positive malware infections to coerce customers into paying for unnecessary repair services
Scareware tactics involving rigged scan results triggered by user responses to specific questions
Impacted Systems: Laptops and computers brought to Office Depot centers
Attack Vector: In-store PC Health Check scan procedure initiated by Office Depot employees
Indicators of Compromise: False malware infection results from PC Health Check scans
Class-action lawsuit settlement by Support.com and AOL in 2013 for similar scareware tactics
